research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Chainalysis is researching systems and methods for identifying patterns in blockchain activities, as described in 'Systems and methods for identifying patterns in blockchain activities.' The abstract details the use of artificial intelligence models that analyze multi-modal blockchain data, even when training data contains a high proportion of missing data points. This research focuses on enhancing blockchain data analysis and pattern recognition capabilities.

overview_description.description:
Chainalysis designs and develops anti-money laundering software for Bitcoin businesses. Its products include REACTOR, an interactive investigation tool that identifies offenders, visualizes data, and shares results with people and organizations, and API, a transaction-based risk scoring solution that contains the source and destination of funds to measure risk.

Chainalysis also offers activity monitoring reports and diligence tools, which allow analysts to estimate criminal revenues and emerging threats. It offers activity monitoring reports, due diligence tools, and cyber threats from the deep web for financial institutions, real-time application programming interface (API), web-based investigation software for due diligence, and verification of customers for bitcoin business, and web-based investigation tools to identify cyber-criminals, identification of bitcoin extortion payments made by victims to criminals, and attribution for cyber threat intelligence industries.

product.description: A blockchain investigation platform for tracing cryptocurrency flows, analyzing transaction networks, discovering leads, and investigating illicit activity across multiple chains and Web3 infrastructure.

product.name: Chainalysis KYT
product.description: A cryptocurrency transaction monitoring solution that screens activity continuously and in real time to identify risky exposure, support compliance, and help prevent illicit transactions.

product.name: Chainalysis DS
product.description: A blockchain data and analytics solution for creating bespoke analyses, generating insights, and configuring alerts to support lead generation and data-driven decisions.

product.name: Chainalysis Address Screening
product.description: A solution for evaluating cryptocurrency wallet addresses against on-chain intelligence to identify potential risks and support compliance decisions.

product.name: Chainalysis VASP Risking
product.description: A risk-assessment solution for evaluating virtual asset service providers and identifying potential exposure to compliance and illicit-finance risks.

product.name: Hexagate Web3 Security
product.description: A Web3 security solution for detecting and preventing cyber exploits, scams, and financial risks affecting blockchain protocols, networks, asset managers, and exchanges.
